title: WorkspaceUpdate
description: Request body for updating an existing workspace.

size.description: Updated size designation for the workspace. Changing size causes a brief workspace restart.

cacheConfig.description: Updated cache multiplier. Valid values are 1, 2, or 4.

AutoSuspendConfig.description: Configuration controlling automatic suspension of a workspace after a period of inactivity to reduce compute costs.

suspended.description: When true, auto-suspend is enabled and the workspace will suspend after the specified idle interval.

suspendAfterSeconds.description: Number of seconds of inactivity after which the workspace is automatically suspended.
